prompt:
Subject:
Amber Light Glass

Main Subject:
A vertically oriented shot from the head to upper thighs of a woman in her 20s holding a transparent rock glass at a counter seat in a Japanese-style bar bathed in warm amber lighting. The woman occupies the center-to-right side of the screen, with her head in the upper center, her chest and waist in the center, and her left thigh extending to the lower right. She sits shallowly on a low black chair, resting her upper body on the counter to the left. She holds the glass at chest height with her right hand, her left forearm lowered diagonally in front of her waist, and her left hand resting limply on her thigh. Her face is tilted to her right while her gaze flows to the lower left, and her body is oriented slightly to the right of the front.

Person/Expression:
A small oval face, warm light beige skin, thin dark brown eyebrows, downcast brown eyes, delicate eyeliner and long lashes, pale rose cheeks, and glossy coral beige lips. A quiet expression with the chin slightly lowered and the corners of the mouth barely relaxed. Hair is dark brown, in a loose low updo at the back of the head. Thin bangs and long stray hairs fall over the forehead, cheeks, and neck, with fine warm-toned highlights on the top and left side of the hair. She wears small gold swinging earrings, a thin gold chain with a tiny pendant, and a delicate bracelet on her left wrist.

Clothing/Pose:
A champagne ivory cache-coeur long dress with thin shoulder straps. Deep V-neckline, fine vertical pleats with a subtle sheen, diagonal draping from under the chest to the waist, and wrinkles gathered at her left hip. The skirt follows her seated thighs, with a deep slit on her left side showing her left thigh, and the hem flowing to the bottom and right edge. A transparent tulle shawl of the same color falls from her shoulders to both arms, creating a fine lattice weave and soft wrinkles. The right hand naturally wraps around the cylindrical transparent glass with the thumb and four fingers, and the glass contains a small amount of amber liquid and one large transparent ice cube. The fingers of the left hand are naturally bent on the thigh.

Background/Light:
A glossy black stone counter extends diagonally to the left, showing fine gold veins and reflections of lighting. On the counter are a small black square plate of brown snacks, a white cloth, long thin metal bar tools, and a large black vase with thin pale cherry blossom branches. Dark wooden shelves in the back left line up multiple wine bottles, each section illuminated squarely by internal warm-colored lights. A small tabletop lantern with vertical lattice is in the lower left. In the back right are wooden shoji screens, a scroll with a faint ink painting, low stone or wood walls, and two tiers of square lanterns. The primary light is from multiple warm-colored lights in the front left and back right, casting soft amber light on the face, shoulders, chest, arms, dress, and glass. The background and chair sink into deep black and dark brown shadows.

Composition/Camera:
A vertical shot close to 2:3, a thigh-up portrait slightly looking down from the subject's chest height. The face is in the upper center, the deep V-neckline in the center, the right hand and glass in the right center, the left hand in the lower center, and the bright thigh in the lower right. The person occupies about 90% of the screen height, with the dress hem and thigh naturally cut at the bottom edge, and the shawl and glass at the right edge. The left counter serves as a strong diagonal leading to the wine shelf in the back, while the shoji and lanterns on the right create depth. The face, eyes, right hand, glass, and dress neckline are sharp, while the wine bottles and flower branches are softly blurred. The calm compression of a standard to short portrait lens.

Texture/Style:
A high-resolution realistic night bar photograph. Based on champagne ivory, warm skin tones, amber, gold, dark brown, and black. Clearly depicts natural skin texture and soft luster, fine stray hairs, minute pleats and sheen of the dress, the lattice of the transparent shawl, refraction of the glass and ice, specular reflection of the stone counter, and the light from wooden shelves, wine bottles, and washi lanterns. Deep shadows are maintained while retaining gradations in the face and white clothing, finished with modest film grain and a warm low-light cinematic tone.

Negative:
Avoid collapsed face or downcast eyes, extra fingers, fusion of right hand and glass, unnatural shapes of ice or liquid, deformation of arms or wrists, poor contact between seating and chair, fusion of thigh and dress, failure of slits or shawls, overlapping of wine bottles or shelves, perspective distortion of counter and shoji, contradictions in lighting and reflection, legible bottle text, logo, watermark, and excessive skin processing.
